Monsters, Inc.
Rating:
G
Runtime:
1h 35min
Release Date:
November 2, 2001
Genre:
Adventure, Animation, Comedy, Family
Lovable Sulley and his wisecracking sidekick Mike Wazowski are the top scare team at Monsters, Inc., the scream-processing factory in Monstropolis. When a little girl named Boo wanders into their world, it's the monsters who are scared silly, and it's up to Sulley and Mike to keep her out of sight and get her back home.

The Characters
Sulley's scare assistant, best friend, and roommate doesn't want any interruptions in his life—especially in his relationships. Although Mike thinks Boo is a "killing machine" at first, he later finds she's a great audience for his natural comedic talent. Occupation: Scare Assistant Description: One-eyed, green sphere with arms, legs and small horns. BFF: His roommate and co-worker, Sulley Enemy: Randall Boggs Crush: Celia, aka: Schmoopsie-Poo Biggest Fear: Human children even Boo Famous Phrase: "You know I am so romantic, sometimes I think I should just marry myself!" Quirks: Possessive of his teddy bear, Little Mikey Did you know?: Celia sometimes calls him Googly-Bear!
Sulley may be the most celebrated monster in Monstropolis, but that doesn't make him mean. When the softhearted monster has to care for Boo, he discovers that love and laughter are more powerful than making kids scream. Nickname: Sulley Occupation: Scarer at Monsters, Inc. Description: 8-feet tall with purple-spotted blue hair Famous Phrase: "Hey, may the best monster win" BFF: His roommate and co-worker, Mike Wazowski Claim to Fame: "Scarer of the Month" for three consecutive months. Biggest Fear: Human children until he meets Boo Dislikes: Exercising
Five-eyed monster with crab-like legs Occupation: CEO of Monsters, Inc. Henchman: Randall Boggs Career Goal: Saving the company at any cost Favorite Hang-Out: The Scare Floor Favorite Outfit: Red vest and waistcoat Notable Quote: "Kids these days. They just don't scare well." Claim to Fame: Personally trained the industry's top Scarers Fun Fact: Started working at Monsters, Inc. as a Scarer
Purple one-eyed monster with five snakes for hair. Occupation: Receptionist at Monsters, Inc. Crush: Mike Wazowski, a.k.a. Googly Bear Favorite Outfit: Green-scale mini dress Favorite Food: Sushi at Harryhausen's Fun Facts: The snakes on Celia's head reflect her mood Did you know?: When she's not referring to him as "Googly Bear," she's the only one to call Mike by his full name, Michael. He, on the other hand, calls her "Schmoopsie Poo."
Boo has a vocabulary of about three words, but that doesn't stop this curious human girl from stealing Sulley's heart and overcoming her fear of Randall. Occupation: Little girl Description: Wide-eyed, pig-tailed tot BFF: Sulley, aka: Kitty Biggest Fear: The monster in her closet Favorite Outfits: Pink pajamas or purple monster costume Famous Phrases: "Boo!" "Kitty," and "Mike Wazowski!" Favorite Toy: Mike's teddy bear Purple one-eyed monster with five snakes for hair Occupation: Receptionist at Monsters, Inc. Crush: Mike Wazowski, akaL Googly Bear Favorite Outfit: Green-scale mini dress Favorite Food: Sushi at Harryhausen's Fun Facts: The snakes on Celia's head reflect her mood Did you know?: When she's not referring to him as "Googly Bear," she's the only one to call Mike by his full name, Michael. He, on the other hand, calls her "Schmoopsie Poo."
Giant slug with horn-rimmed glasses Occupation: Dispatch Manger at Monsters, Inc. Distinguishing Features: A beauty mark on her chin Favorite Outfit: Cat-eye glasses, red sweater, and red lips Biggest Secret: Working undercover for the CDA Famous Phrases: "I'm watching you Wazowski. Always watching..." Claim to Fame: Nabbing Mr. Waternoose for his devious plot to kidnap human children and extract their screams Likes: Paperwork Dislikes: Improperly filed Scare Reports
Large, six-limbed purple reptile Occupation: Scarer at Monsters, Inc. Enemy: James P. Sullivan, aka: Sulley Sidekick: His slimy assistant Fungus Career Goal: To beat Sulley's Scare Score Claim to Fame: Invents a scream-extraction device Special Skills: Chameleon-like ability to change color and blend into his environment, making him invisible
